info.description: DriftCheck grades AI-generated images and video against the reference they were supposed to match, before you spend another regeneration credit. POST a candidate image and its reference and get a drift score with a pass/warn/fail verdict, per-method similarity parts (difference hash, perceptual hash, global SSIM, color histogram, graded on the subject art and against the best-matching region of the reference), a proportion report that flags subject or emblem scale divergence in bounding-box share points, and a text check that reports its own OCR availability honestly. POST a video with its reference still and get per-frame drift scores, the worst frames with timestamps, and frozen-span detection for clips that hold a still instead of staying in motion. Every failure is a structured JSON error. Classical metrics only - no identity recognition claims; see the response notes for exactly what each score can and cannot prove.
info.title: DriftCheck

post.description: Send candidate and reference as multipart file fields (candidate, reference), or as JSON with candidate_url / reference_url or candidate_base64 / reference_base64. Optional expected_text is checked against OCR of the candidate when an OCR engine is available on the host; the response reports OCR availability either way.

200.description: drift_score (0-100, blended: 0.7 similarity + 0.3 proportion penalty), verdict pass/warn/fail, score_composition, similarity {full_frame, best_region} with per-method parts, proportion {candidate, reference, divergence_points, flag, penalty}, text_check {ocr, expected_text, expected_found}, notes, _meta
